messages.english: Field seed sourcing · cycles without nursery raising
messages.translation: Saatgutbeschaffung für das Freiland · Zyklen ohne Jungpflanzenanzucht

messages.english: Use accepted saved field cycles that have no nursery phase. No nursery phase does not establish botanical direct sowing. Enter your own gross whole-seed requirement; final plant positions are not seed counts.
messages.translation: Verwenden Sie akzeptierte gespeicherte Freilandzyklen, die keine Anzuchtphase haben. Das Fehlen einer Anzuchtphase belegt keine botanische Direktsaat. Geben Sie Ihren eigenen Bruttobedarf als ganzzahlige Samenzahl ein; endgültige Pflanzenpositionen sind keine Samenzahlen.

messages.english: Planning only, not a whole-farm purchase list. No stock is recorded, order placed or plan saved. Unknown counts are not zero. Nursery equipment and a nursery review horizon are not required for this separate field worksheet.
messages.translation: Nur Planung, keine Einkaufsliste für den gesamten Betrieb. Es wird kein Bestand erfasst, keine Bestellung aufgegeben oder ein Plan gespeichert. Unbekannte Zahlen sind nicht null. Anzuchtausrüstung und ein Betrachtungszeitraum für die Anzuchtprüfung sind für dieses separate Freilandarbeitsblatt nicht erforderlich.

messages.english: Field seed sourcing · cycles without nursery raising
messages.translation: Approvvigionamento sementi in pieno campo · cicli senza coltivazione in vivaio

messages.english: Use accepted saved field cycles that have no nursery phase. No nursery phase does not establish botanical direct sowing. Enter your own gross whole-seed requirement; final plant positions are not seed counts.
messages.translation: Utilizza i cicli in pieno campo salvati e accettati che non hanno una fase di vivaio. L'assenza di una fase di vivaio non dimostra la semina diretta botanica. Inserisci il tuo fabbisogno lordo come numero intero di semi; le posizioni finali delle piante non sono conteggi di semi.

messages.english: Planning only, not a whole-farm purchase list. No stock is recorded, order placed or plan saved. Unknown counts are not zero. Nursery equipment and a nursery review horizon are not required for this separate field worksheet.
messages.translation: Solo pianificazione, non un elenco di acquisto per l'intera azienda. Nessuna scorta viene registrata, nessun ordine effettuato né alcun piano salvato. I conteggi sconosciuti non sono zero. L'attrezzatura per vivaio e un orizzonte di revisione del vivaio non sono richiesti per questo foglio di lavoro separato per il pieno campo.

messages.translation: Il CSV include esattamente le etichette dei gruppi di fornitura inserite, inclusi gli spazi. Ometti le informazioni che non desideri nel file. Gli ID privati di associazione salvati e i riferimenti a singole varietà o lotti non sono inclusi.

reviewNotes: Unreviewed AI translation drafts for German (de) and Italian (it) field seed UI copy. Intended drafting boundaries: (1) Absence of a nursery phase describes an operational planning distinction without implying biological impossibility or proving botanical direct sowing; (2) Whole-seed requirements and counts in rows 02 and 08 are translated as integer quantities (ganzzahlige Samenzahl, numero intero di semi) rather than unbroken physical integrity; (3) Explicit material declaration is maintained; (4) Exact ASCII literals DEMO and CSV are preserved verbatim; (5) Blank remains unknown while confirmed zero is an explicit planning entry. Drafting corrections applied: replaced Baumschule with generic Jungpflanzenanzucht, and avoided compound Anzuchtpruefhorizont in favor of Betrachtungszeitraum für die Anzuchtprüfung. Remaining checks for human reviewers: verify horticultural naturalness of Freiland / pieno campo and Jungpflanzenanzucht / vivaio in local farming contexts. No runtime language activation or semantic certification is claimed.
